title: Close a reconciliation review
caption: Mirrors tools/e2e/specs/ota-admin/reconciliation-review.e2e.ts. To get such a booking locally: an airline-card booking completed with the stub scenario server-error on an OTA without a booking queue, then wait past reconcile_until (15 min).

steps.title: Not booked: a bad note
steps.body: Open the first, **Close the review** → **Not booked**, write a note containing a card number, confirm.
steps.expect: "A note never holds a card number: remove it." at the note; dialog stays open; nothing changed.

steps.title: Not booked
steps.body: Write what you looked for; confirm.
steps.expect: "Failed", payment failed (airline card) or released (Stripe); `booking.reconcile_closed` in the timeline; `reconcile_outcome = not_found`; `booking.reconcile_close` staff action with the note.

steps.title: Order found: wrong locator
steps.body: Second booking → **Order found** with a locator of an order without the remark `VELEXIS <reference>`.
steps.expect: Refusal at the record locator; nothing changed.

steps.title: Order found
steps.body: The locator of the order that carries the remark (lower case is fine).
steps.expect: "Confirmed", the record locator on the page, `reconcile_outcome = found`; the view is then empty ("No reconciliation waits for staff.").
